verification_methodology.disclosure: Situated on surveyed Nova-Wanderland Brick Homes and Crosswalk (`1giQzzRD71Qih-D0Kg-107HJX1KjjKZx5`). Two separately timed pedestrian crossing stages separated by a central refuge island (`x in [-0.45, +0.45]`): Stage 1 walk signal is GREEN `t = 0.0..6.5 s`, while Stage 2 walk signal remains RED until `t = 8.4 s` (turning GREEN `t = 8.4..14.0 s`). Clearpath Husky guides a parent (`Female_Adult_03`) and child (`Male_Child_01`). Safe Husky reads Stage 2's independent red signal, pauses the family cleanly on the central refuge island until `t = 8.4 s`, then completes Stage 2 on green; unsafe Husky treats Stage 1 green as whole-street clearance and leads the family into Stage 2 during the red phase.
